dependency_status.xorg_live_gate: Deferred by user instruction to the concentrated hkust4 final gate after CL-16d.

implementation_choice.reason: The existing headed Playwright, VNC, recording and formal artifact stack is synchronous; one owner thread preserves the locked browser lifecycle without a cross-protocol rewrite.

allowed_deltas: ThreadOwnedSyncBackendAdapter owns one FIFO daemon worker with explicit submit/run/call/close lifecycle and observable pending/active/thread state
the owner-thread queue is bounded, submit and stop insertion are serialized, and a timed-out close can be retried
PlaywrightBrowserDriver records its construction thread and rejects every public browser action or close from another thread
Coworker constructs Playwright, runs all legacy tool calls and observation captures, and closes tracing/context/playwright on the same owner thread
Coworker trace, transcript, console and FastAPI presentation mirroring are ordered on the owner thread and drained before finalize
the adapter is borrowed by ApplicationRuntime; the outer Coworker turn retains browser, recording, environment process and adapter cleanup ownership
generic non-Coworker legacy tools retain the CL-16b controlled worker fallback
test_commands: uv run pytest -q -m 'not live_api and not live_alfworld and not live_mcp and not live_coworker and not stress'
uv run ruff check src tests scripts/v19_release scripts/coworker_demo
uv run python -m compileall -q src tests scripts/v19_release scripts/coworker_demo

evidence.details: Construction, 16 ordered calls, observation bind/capture, event mirroring and cleanup use one owner thread; direct cross-thread Playwright calls fail before touching the page.

A cancelled queued call never reaches the backend, mutating in-flight timeout/cancel remains outcome_unknown through the canonical pipeline, backend exceptions do not kill the worker, bounded backpressure is observable, and close drains queued work or remains safely retryable after timeout.

Coworker entry prunes completed mirrors, drains every remaining future even after a failure, always runs the owner-thread fence, and aggregates cleanup errors. The outer turn closes Playwright and the worker before environment client/process teardown and refuses unsafe dependency teardown if the worker remains alive.
Existing normal/anomaly/rollback, 24-node ground truth, presentation projection, trace order, provider retry identity and formal artifact regressions remain green.
1122 passed, 11 deselected, with one existing Starlette/httpx warning; Coworker current non-live set 442 passed, 3 live deselected.

findings.summary: The default application pipeline had no application-wide keyed physical-resource scheduler.
findings.reverification: factory injection, same/distinct backend partitioning and production-wired 32-session stress pass with all counters zero

findings.summary: Batch exception isolation swallowed task-level CancelledError and could continue later calls.
findings.reverification: batch cancellation during execution and lease wait propagates and starts no later sibling call

findings.summary: The shared deadline did not cover context summary preparation or provider stream close.
findings.reverification: both operations use bounded deadline cancellation/join and parent cancellation remains CancelledError

findings.summary: Coworker cleanup could skip event futures or the owner-thread fence, and adapter close timeout could not be retried safely.
findings.reverification: cleanup aggregates every failure, always fences, preserves dependency ordering and retry-close regression passes

findings.summary: Coworker event mirroring retained an unbounded owner-thread queue and completed futures.
findings.reverification: adapter queue capacity is bounded, completed futures are pruned, and all failed mirrors are drained

findings.summary: Stress fixtures did not exercise the production scheduler or true stale/fresh resource overlap.
findings.reverification: 32 sessions use the canonical pipeline and 100 races overlap late stale completion with a waiting fresh generation

reviews.disposition: all six findings remediated and verified in the same review round; no second grouped review permitted
